outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the differentiation protocol, not a plot with statistical comparisons.
Panel B shows western blot images, not a quantitative plot with significance symbols.

Panel C consists of line plots of gene expression over time with error bars, but no significance symbols (e.g., asterisks) are present on the plots or mentioned in the caption, so there is nothing to assess for a significance-level definition.
Panel D shows live fluorescence images, not a plot.
Panel E shows flow cytometry dot plots with gated percentages, but no statistical significance symbols are used.
Panel F is a line plot of positive cell proportions with error bars; no significance symbols appear on the plot or in the caption.
Panel G is a line plot of positive cell proportions with error bars; no significance symbols appear on the plot or in the caption.
Panel H shows immunostaining micrographs, not a plot.
Panel I shows Tukey boxplots of normalized read counts across sorted populations; no statistical significance symbols are displayed or referenced in the caption.
Panel J shows hierarchical clustering heatmaps of expression Z-scores, not a plot with significance testing symbols.
